newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady to firm,enquiries healthy.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady to firm,enquiries healthy.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were were steady to firm on healthy enquiries while sellers hoped to cash-in and sell off excess supplies, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $97 a tonne and 180-cst at $105 by majors with independents indicating even lower levels.
"Demand is quite good, but I wonder how long prices can stay this firm," said a trader.
"If cargo prices fall again later tonight, bunker prices could just follow suit," he said.
